anya (Product): BeaconCorp just asked for a pilot: private deploy, BYOK, per-tenant KV cache, 100ms P95. They want next-week window. Can we scope an MVP?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Short: feasible with tradeoffs. BYOK avoids HSM latency but needs envelope flow. Per-tenant cache increases RAM. To hit 100ms we must pick a small model or quantized variant.

mike (Infra): Reserved GPUs + prewarm needed for 100ms P95. Standard provisioning 10bd; can compress to 5bd with exec sign-off. Also need network routes to customer KMS.

lina (Security): Full HSM path = ~3w for attestation and review. BYOK pilot possible under exception; I can draft exception + audit checklist in 48h, legal sign-off required.

carol (Eng-SRE): Observability: per-tenant latency dashboard, token cost, alert at 120ms. Recommend canary traffic limited to BeaconCorp + synthetic spike tests and automatic fallback to hosted model.

anya (Product): Two options: Fast = BYOK pilot (~7bd); Secure = HSM route (~4w). Proposal: choose Fast for pilot, owners: sam runtime, mike infra, lina security, carol canary. Ack + ETAs?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Ack. 72h to add BYOK flag, envelope encryption, and fallback.

mike (Infra): Ack. 5bd to provision reserved nodes; 3bd with exec sign-off.

lina (Security): Ack. Exception draft 48h, then legal review.

carol (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook + dashboards by Thursday; will include rollback playbook.

ops-bot: Created ticket BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT: https://tickets/BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT — owners assigned, please update timelines.

anya (Product): Great—I'll confirm scope with BeaconCorp: "BYOK + per-tenant cache + 100ms P95 target; traffic scoped to pilot." Weekly M/W standups. Reopen if blockers. :v:
